hana (People Ops): Quick update: small but important change to the calibration scoring rubric and how we document conflicts of interest. pls read.

miguel (People Ops): TL;DR: Scores now include a short "evidence tag" required for any 1-point or 2-point deviation from manager expectation. Tag options: impact, quality, ownership, scope.

dana (Cal Lead): Why the tag?

hana (People Ops): Helps chairs quickly surface why a score diverges without hunting through text. It also feeds the calibration heatmap.

tom (Eng Manager): Is the tag mandatory? will it block submit?\n
miguel (People Ops): Mandatory for >1 point deviation. It's a required field that pops up when you change the anchor by 2+ points. Minor deviations don't require it.

rachael (Manager - Product): How should managers teach reviewers to use tags?

dana (Cal Lead): Ask reviewers to pick the primary reason for the divergence. We prefer one tag per comment; free text still allowed for context.

notify-bot: Reminder set: Calibration rubric Q&A 15 min drop-in  Apr 03 16:00 UTC.

tom (Eng Manager): COI flow? last cycle a reviewer was pulled in by the IC's peer.

hana (People Ops): New step: reviewers now must declare COI when they accept the reviewer invite (checkbox + short reason). If COI checked, the review is auto-queued to an independent reviewer pool and People Ops is notified.

miguel (People Ops): For borderline cases, set COI = "consulted previously" and we'll review. We won't auto-reassign without human triage for that flag.

dana (Cal Lead): Will COI flags be visible to chairs?

hana (People Ops): Visible to chairs and People Ops only; not to ICs or the wider packet. Audit trail kept for 2 years.

rachael (Manager - Product): Any timeline impact?

miguel (People Ops): No change to core dates. Minor reassigns may add up to 48 hours for that individual's review being completed, but we'll prioritize to avoid delaying the cohort.

tom (Eng Manager): Any sample wording for reviewers?

dana (Cal Lead): Added a two-line sample in the reviewer invite: "Please provide concrete examples tied to the tag (link to artifacts if possible). If you have a conflict of interest, check the box and give a short reason."

hana (People Ops): Form link (rubric v1.3): https://redwood.app/forms/rubric?id=RUB-2026-03. Try the flow in the sandbox workspace if you want to preview.

miguel (People Ops): We'll push a one-email summary to managers tomorrow and run a 10-min drop-in during office hours.

rachael (Manager - Product): Thanks  i'll share with my managers and encourage using tags in their prep.

hana (People Ops): Thanks all  ping @miguel or @dana with questions or edge cases. :white_check_mark:
